# Edit a draft comment before publication.

as 'Test <test@example.com>'
at '2024-04-05T16:40:32Z'

# setup
cd repo
git init
git commit --allow-empty -m 'Initial commit'
gs repo init

# set up a fake GitHub remote
shamhub-setup
shamhub new origin alice/example.git
shamhub register alice
git push origin main

env SHAMHUB_USERNAME=alice
gs auth login

# create a branch with a file and submit it
git add main.go
gs bc -m 'Add main' feature1
gs branch submit --fill
stderr 'Created #'

# draft a comment
gs review comment main.go:3 -m 'Original comment.'
stderr 'Drafted comment 1'

# edit the draft comment with -m
gs review edit 1 -m 'Updated comment.'
stderr 'Updated draft comment 1'

# verify the edit took effect by listing drafts
gs review list --draft-only
stderr 'Updated comment'

-- repo/main.go --
package main

func main() {
	println("hello")
}
